areas.t: Wednesday Afternoon Update: As of 3:00pm Wednesday, good air quality for fine particulate matter (PM2.5) is seen with calm weather conditions. An area of high pressure is creating very stable air, which may cause a period of moderate air quality tonight as pollutants are trapped near the ground. ***
